notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 82-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.56, bnp 2132, creatinine 0.87, hemoglobin 14.8, platelets 263, sodium 139, wbc 6.5; vitals dbp 76-81, heart_rate 69-72, map 90-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 118-123, spo2 97-98, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 33%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.88, hemoglobin 14.8, platelets 259, sodium 139, wbc 6.2; vitals dbp 77-80, heart_rate 69-73, map 91-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 115-122, spo2 97-98, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 82-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
